title: Compatibility laws of the right-derived unit on complexes
statement: The explicit complex unit is inverse to the K-injective derived-value comparison, natural in complex maps, compatible with exact derived factorization, and compatible with the bounded-below inclusion. These four laws are packaged as a conjunction using the existing private comparison proofs.

source.place: Tags 070I and 015F; quotient comparison and right-derived unit compatibility.

proof.text: Construct the complex unit as the inverse quotient comparison followed by the homotopy right-derived unit and the derived image of the quotient comparison. Use the existing right_unit_Q_obj_iso, right_unit_Q_naturality, exact_factor_Q and right_derived_plus_unit proofs from UnboundedEtaleCompactSupportComparisons to fill the four conjuncts. Their unit has exactly this explicit composite, so the proof is a direct conjunction introduction with no added assumption. Its component equation is proved by unfolding the explicit unit definition once.

proof_origin.place: Tags 070I and 015F; reuse of the existing private comparison proofs.

lean.statement:
theorem derivedComplexUnitCompatibility :
    (∀ (F : C ⥤ D) [F.Additive] (J : CochainComplex C ℤ) [J.IsKInjective],
      derivedComplexUnit F J ≫ (F.rightDerivedFunctorObjQIso J).hom = 𝟙 _) ∧
    (∀ (F : C ⥤ D) [F.Additive] {J I : CochainComplex C ℤ} (ρ : J ⟶ I),
      DerivedCategory.Q.map ((F.mapHomologicalComplex (.up ℤ)).map ρ) ≫
        derivedComplexUnit F I =
        derivedComplexUnit F J ≫ F.rightDerivedFunctor.map (DerivedCategory.Q.map ρ)) ∧
    (∀ (F : C ⥤ D) [F.Additive] [PreservesFiniteLimits F] [PreservesFiniteColimits F]
      (J : CochainComplex C ℤ),
      F.mapDerivedCategoryFactorsh.inv.app ((HomotopyCategory.quotient C (.up ℤ)).obj J) ≫
          F.mapDerivedCategory.map ((DerivedCategory.quotientCompQhIso C).hom.app J) ≫
          F.mapDerivedCategoryFactors.hom.app J =
        (DerivedCategory.quotientCompQhIso D).hom.app
          ((F.mapHomologicalComplex (.up ℤ)).obj J)) ∧
    (∀ [EnoughInjectives C] (F : C ⥤ D) [F.Additive] (K : HomotopyCategory.Plus C),
      DerivedCategory.Plus.ι.map (F.rightDerivedFunctorPlusUnit.app K) ≫
          F.rightDerivedFunctorPlusCompatibility.hom.app (DerivedCategory.Plus.Qh.obj K) =
        F.rightDerivedFunctorUnit.app ((HomotopyCategory.Plus.ι C).obj K))
